seasons.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
seasons.quote: Aegle marmelos (L.) Correa (Family: Rutaceae) is a deciduous tree, 6.0 to 10 m in height

tree_spacing_m.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
tree_spacing_m.quote: Seedlings or budded plants are transplanted in the field at a spacing of 10-12 m.

years_to_bear.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
years_to_bear.quote: Budded plants start bearing fruits at the age of 4-5 years, whereas seedling trees require 7-8 years.

water_need.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
water_need.quote: The field after plantation should be irrigated periodically as and when required weekly or fortnightly.
water_need.note: Watering the young plantation weekly or fortnightly is read as 'low'; a Vikaspedia companion page calls bael a 'fruit for dryland'.

source_notes: AI research batch 16 (2026-10-08). Ayurvedic fruit tree (bilva); values are the lower end of the quoted range.
